objective: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

description: Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.
Leave me, <name>. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.
And please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.
progress: You have returned. Are you ready to battle a succubus?
completion: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, <name>. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
